positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "1 year ago, #SCOTUS ripped the promise of reproductive freedom from millions of Americans. MAGA extremists have spent every day since pursuing a national abortion ban. See my statement on my bill to give women back their freedom with a Reproductive Health Travel Fund."
"48 years ago, Roe v. Wade established the legal right to abortion. Today, we celebrate that victory and commit to making sure everyone has equal access regardless of income, race, and ZIP code. "
"Access to reproductive health care is a fundamental right. Period. Congress must codify Roe into law. I will continue fighting to ensure that happens."
"MAGA-extremists continue to put #ReproductiveRights under attack. As Planned Parenthood's Champion for Reproductive Health, I will continue highlighting disparities caused by the fall of Roe."
